proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ s A B hA hB
  have hA' : ‖A -ᵥ s.center‖ = s.radius := by rw [← dist_eq_norm_vsub V]; exact hA
  have hB' : ‖B -ᵥ s.center‖ = s.radius := by rw [← dist_eq_norm_vsub V]; exact hB
  have hm : midpoint ℝ A B -ᵥ s.center = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • ((A -ᵥ s.center) + (B -ᵥ s.center)) := by
    rw [midpoint_vsub, smul_add]; simp
  rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub V (midpoint ℝ A B), dist_eq_norm_vsub V A B, hm, ← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right A B s.center, norm_smul]
  have hp := parallelogram_law_with_norm ℝ (A -ᵥ s.center) (B -ᵥ s.center)
  rw [hA', hB', vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right] at hp
  norm_num
  nlinarith
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (A B : P), A ∈ s → B ∈ s → dist (midpoint ℝ A B) s.center ^ 2 + (dist A B / 2) ^ 2 = s.radius ^ 2
